name: Ro20-8552
summary: Ro20-8552 is a benzodiazepine derivative with sedative and anxiolytic effects, which has been sold as a designer drug.

pharmacology.text: Ro20-8552 is a benzodiazepine derivative with sedative and anxiolytic effects, which has been sold as a designer drug.

uses.text: Ro20-8552 is a benzodiazepine derivative with sedative and anxiolytic effects, which has been sold as a designer drug.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Benzodiazepines as a group cause drowsiness, poor coordination, memory problems and slowed reactions. Regular use leads to dependence, and stopping suddenly after heavy use can cause dangerous withdrawal, including seizures.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平類整體而言會引起嗜睡、協調變差、記憶問題和反應變慢。規律使用會導致依賴，長期大量使用後突然停用可能出現危險的戒斷症狀，包括癲癇發作。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。苯二氮平类整体而言会引起嗜睡、协调制差、记忆问题和反应变慢。规律使用会导致依赖，长期大量使用后突然停用可能出现危险的戒断症状，包括癫痫发作。

fact.en: Like many designer benzodiazepines, it was first made at Hoffmann-La Roche decades ago and never developed, then appeared on the research chemical market much later.
fact.zh: 和許多設計型苯二氮平一樣，它在數十年前由羅氏藥廠首次合成，當時未進一步開發，很久之後才出現在研究化學品市場上。
fact.zhHans: 和许多设计型苯二氮平一样，它在数十年前由罗氏药厂首次合成，当时未进一步开发，很久之后才出现在研究化学品市场上。
